digest.component_or_area: plan-review attestation and dependency scope inheritance
propositions: A live child declared `none` is neutral in scope inheritance: it contributes no paths and does not poison sibling path declarations.
Any live undeclared child poisons child-path inheritance and prevents promotion of an undeclared parent to `none`; all-none scope requires every live child to be authenticated `none`.
Mixed-scope containers with both `paths` and `none` children must sign only the path-child dependencies and survive unrelated file drift.
Cheap resign must preserve child-derived signed scope using the immutable relation snapshot without network reads.
P9 must pass declared-none leaves and containers whose all live children are declared; it must advise only live undeclared children and offer both path declaration and `--none` as remedies.
